title: Fixer contract — schema companion
description: JSON Schema for `.pkit/capabilities/project-management/schemas/fixer-contract.yaml`: the run's contract of a fixer as data (project-management:DEC-056 points 3 and 6). It holds the lead every result line starts with, the three forms of a result line, and the fixed list of `none` reasons, each with what clears it. The drift command reads them from the YAML, never from prose. `contract_version` is the version of `pkit::work-tracking:fixers` the contract belongs to.

contract_version.description: The version of the fixers point this contract is the point's at (DEC-056 point 1).

lead.description: What a result line starts with, once the whitespace around it is stripped. Every form starts with it.

forms.description: The three forms of a result line, one for each state a fixer gives an artefact. Each holds the placeholders `<agent>` and `<artefact>`.

reasons.description: The `none` reasons, each keyed by the code a `none` line carries, with what clears it: the artefact's friction, the setup, or the next run.
